mount.__note: LOAD-BEARING. Carbon themes are CLASS SCOPES (.cds--white/.cds--g10/.cds--g90/.cds--g100), never :root — a page without the <Theme> wrapper renders pixel-correct (every var() carries a literal fallback) while EVERY custom property resolves EMPTY at :root, so the CSS-vars reader verifies zero candidates and the round yields ZERO source facts in silence. Verified by probe: getComputedStyle(:root)['--cds-layer-01'] = '' vs '#f4f4f4' inside .cds--white. The wrapper's implicit cds--layer-one context is what makes the layer/field token family resolve too.

enumeration.__note: unsetLabel is "unset", NOT the drafter's default "__unset". CARBON FINDING: Carbon is the first library through the pipeline with a DEFAULTLESS enum axis that reaches minting (Button/Tag/TextInput/Modal/IconButton size, Accordion size, Tag type). The pseudo-value becomes a SEGMENT of every minted token path (imported.tag.root.background-color.{type}.unset), and the contract token-ref regex is /^\{[a-z0-9.{}-]+\}$/i — underscores are not in that class, so "__unset" fails ContractSchema.parse at the end of fusion with a wall of brace-wrapping errors that never mention the underscore. The field exists to be configurable and loadConfig refuses a collision with a real axis value by name, so this is a CONFIG fix, not an engine one — but extract/draft-capture-config.ts still DRAFTS "__unset", so the next defaultless-axis library hits the same wall (named in examples/carbon/PROVENANCE.md).

components.__note: size is DEFAULTLESS (Carbon's destructure has no fallback) — the __unset pseudo-value leads the axis. Sizing does NOT ride a per-component rule: the size prop emits BOTH .cds--btn--<size> (no CSS) and .cds--layout--size-<size> (the real rule, reading the :root layout tokens), which is why the :root layout block is in the DTCG base.

components.__note: 2-deep childrenSpec (the organism round's recursive grammar). NAMED DEFERRAL: Carbon has no `type` enum — the line/contained distinction is a BOOLEAN `contained` on TabList, a CHILD, and the axis grammar cannot reach a child prop. `contained` is pinned false (line tabs); a Contained axis needs child-prop enumeration and is out of round 1. DETERMINISM PIN (witnessed, not precautionary): UNCONTROLLED, Carbon's TabList defaults to activation:'automatic', so the focus-visible driver's Tab keypress SELECTS whichever tab it lands on and the selection survived into the next sweep — the double-run self-check failed with Tab 0's border-block-end-color reading rgba(15,98,254) in run 1 and rgba(224,224,224) in run 2 (and the list width jittering 261.781 vs 261.922px as the selected tab's bolder text remeasured). `selectedIndex: 0` + the onChange callback makes it CONTROLLED (useControllableState), which is the same fix MUI Tabs carries as `value: 0`.
